meta.title: A District Savings Account
meta.author: Portland Public School District
meta.description:
This week in our Budget 101 series, we're explaining what our Fund Balance means and why long-term planning in critical.

Every other Wednesday, we'll share a new video as we aim to break down the big stuff. We're giving you our district budget in bite-sized, easy-to-understand videos. Because budgets shouldn’t be a mystery, they should make sense.

Stay tuned for Part 6: "Why Cuts Happen” — coming soon!
